title: Light Stick
description: A mod for Neoforge that adds a blue light stick
body:
# Light Stick
Light Stick is a very simple mod that adds the blue light stick to Neoforge 1.21.4! I made this quick mod for my Miku Concert Map and will be added to Miku Concert Modpack

## Additions
The only addition to the game in this mod which is the blue light stick... yeah not much at all ¯\_(ᵕ—ᴗ—)_/¯
im most likely going to expand this mod afterwards
